Name: Kumi's Seasonal portrait of Wizard
Author: kumijiang
Description:
我真的很喜欢年轻又漂亮的男生，所以我把巫师变成这样了哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
I really like young and beautiful men, so I turned wizards into this hahaha.
[b]I don't know English, so I use all the translators, which may seem strange, I hope you can understand my instructions.[/b]

兼容[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]，你可以在游戏内关闭季节性，并选择你喜欢的季节，仅关闭季节性不设置的情况下默认秋季。
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, you can turn off seasonality in-game and choose the season you like.Only turn off seasonality and do not set the default fall.



[list]
[*]Download the guide：
[/list]7 expression only applies to the SVE base version.
 9 expression is based on the RR mod, if you use the original RR mod, download it.
12 expression is a common version that can be used by both SVE and the original.(Also includes the original)
32 expressions are only compatible with the sve version of the RRRR module.
RR SVE is a module that is compatible with almost all expressions, so feel free.

[list]
[*]If you can't use it:
[/list][list=1]
[*]Make sure you download the pre-mod
[*]Confirm whether other portrait replacement mods are used, if so, it may be that my mod is covered, you can add words (such as Z) in front of my mod name to make my mod load after him
[*] Confirm that the portrait of other love mods is set to "Custom"
[*]If the season cannot be changed, you may try pressing "P"
[/list][list]
[*]如果出现无法使用的问题：
[/list][list=1]
[*]请确保你下载了前置mod
[*]确认是否使用了其他季节性肖像模组，如果是，可能我的模组被覆盖了，可以将我的模组名前面增加单词（比如Z），使我的模组在他后面加载
[*]确认将其他恋爱模组的肖像设置为“自定义”
[*]如果季节不能更换的话，也许可以试试按“P”
[/list]
[list]
[*]I can solve the problem of drawing but not the technical problem, please understand that the technical problem is too difficult for me.
[*]Because I'm lazy, all versions of the walking chart are the same, and I haven't found any conflict bugs so far, because their walking chart movements are not related to each other.
[*]If there is a conflict or a strange walking diagram, please let me know, at least the drawing problem can be solved.
[*][u]（Maybe some mods use meditation for sleep walking diagrams, so it's unlikely to use a dressing gown, but if you use SVE, the nightgown will work normally.）[/u]
[*]我可以解决作画问题但无法解决技术性问题，请谅解，技术性的问题对我来说实在太难了
[*]而且我有偷懒，因此所有版本的行走图都是一样的，目前我还没发现什么冲突错误，因为他们的行走图调动都互不相关，如果发生冲突或行走图奇怪，请告诉我，至少绘画问题我是可以解决的[u]（也许有的模组的睡眠行走图调用的是冥想，所以不太可能使用睡袍，但如果你使用SVE，那睡袍就是可以正常调用的）[/u]
[/list]
